N. 12(E).— In pursuance of Sub-section (1) and (2) of Section 13AA of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 (43 of 1950) and in supersession of notifications issued earlier in this behalf, the Election Commission of India, in consultation with the Government of Union Territory of Ladakh, hereby designates the officers specified in column (3) of the table below as the District Election Officer of the District in the Union Territory of Ladakh specified in column (2) of the said table against such officer:- TABLE Sl. No. Name of District Designation of District Election Officer (1) (2) (3) 1 Leh Deputy Commissioner, Leh 2 Kargil Deputy Commissioner, Kargil [F. No. 508/LDK/2025(DEO)] By Order, ASHWANI KUMAR MOHAL, Secy.
